en: The Ten Precepts I undertake the training precept of abstaining from taking life.
I undertake the training precept of abstaining from taking what is not given.
I undertake the training precept of abstaining from unchastity.
I undertake the training precept of abstaining from false speech.
I undertake the training precept of abstaining from fermented and distilled liquors and intoxicants which are the basis for negligence.
I undertake the training precept of abstaining from eating at improper times.
I undertake the training precept of abstaining from dancing, singing, instrumental music, and witnessing unsuitable spectacles.
I undertake the training precept of abstaining from wearing garlands, using perfumes and ointments, and engaging in adornment and beautification.
I undertake the training precept of abstaining from high and luxurious beds and seats.
I undertake the training precept of abstaining from accepting gold and silver.
